ev.q: Build spaceships, rockets, and vehicles using any imaginable combination of parts
Build it, fly it, crash it, rebuild it
explore moons and planets in the Kerbol solar system
take charge of the space program for the alien race known as the Kerbals
In Sandbox, you are free to build any spacecraft you can think of
You will learn a lot about orbital mechanics
There is so much reading a learning required in this game
300 hours in and I find this game still enjoyable
a fun exploration or building game with funny lil guys
